name: cuROB (CUDA-Based Real Parameter Optimization Benchmark)
description:
Benchmarking is key for developing and comparing optimization algorithms. In
this paper, a CUDA-based real parameter optimization benchmark (cuROB) is
introduced. Test functions of diverse properties are included within cuROB and
implemented efficiently with CUDA. Speedup of one order of magnitude can be
achieved in comparison with CPU-based benchmark of CEC'14.
reputation: Known within the numerical optimization community as a GPU-accelerated test-suite for comparing real-parameter optimizers, but not as broadly cited as legacy CPU-based CEC benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; focuses on real-valued function optimization and CUDA performance; primary caveats are that reported gains include hardware-specific speedups and results depend on chosen function sets and termination budgets.
